messages:
deploy-bot: started canary for release v2026.03.22-rc4 at 08:14Z -> 5% traffic. preflight OK, health checks green. audit: a-1746665432

nina: watching SLO dashboard — /generate p95 (us-east) jumped from 90ms -> 380ms right after shift, error_rate up to 0.7% (mostly 502). grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds/1746665432

lucas: 502s show 'connection reset' to kv-proxy from embed-svc-1. suspect cold connections after new runtime flags. cpu on embed-svc-1 spiked to 92% briefly.

tessa: logs snippet: ```2026-03-22T08:15:11Z embed-svc-1 WARN connection_reset to kv-proxy id=52 route=embeddings```. repeated ~25x over 30s.

alert-bot: Alert: slo.p95.delta > 3x baseline for route=embeddings AND error_rate > 0.5% -> Trigger: CANARY_HOLD.

nina: ops-bot, did deploy-bot auto-hold?

ops-bot: Canary state: PAUSED by auto-rule. current traffic: 5%. reason: p95 spike + elevated 5xx. manual action required to resume.

lucas: recommend pin to previous runtime build (runtime:v3.14) on embeddings route while we investigate kernel flag mismatch. pin avoids rollback of model versions and keeps other routes unaffected.

tessa: agree. Also propose a quick config: lower connection pool timeout on kv-proxy from 2s -> 500ms to reduce retries while we stabilize. I'll open a small change PR.

nina: +1 to pin. if pin takes <2m we do that then run a short soak. steps: 1) pin route 2) small traffic sanity check 3) revert kv timeout tweak if unnecessary

lucas: executing pin now: `POST /internal/routing/pin {"route":"embeddings","target":"runtime:v3.14","reason":"canary hold auto"}`

deploy-bot: routing change applied by lucas at 08:17:03Z -> embeddings pinned to runtime:v3.14. audit a-1746665432.

tessa: filing PR to adjust kv-proxy timeout: #PR-8342. will keep low blast radius and revert after verification.

nina: running sanity playback (100 QPS, 30s) against pinned route. watching p95 and 5xx.

lucas: playback results: p95 back to 95ms, 5xx at 0.05%. connection reset count dropped to near-zero. looks good.

ops-bot: Canary remains PAUSED. Manual resume requires approval from release lead.

nina: I'll request resume in 20m if metrics stable for 10m. create followup ticket: INF-4158 for runtime-flag investigation.

tessa: attaching traces to INF-4158. also adding note to release notes: "v2026.03.22-rc4 paused: embeddings route pinned to runtime:v3.14 due to transient p95/502s during canary. monitoring and postmortem in INF-4158."

lucas: added routing comment: "pinned during canary - investigate connection pooling and kernel selection"

deploy-bot: deployment log updated: canary paused 5% traffic (1746665432).

nina: thumbs up. closing this thread for immediate action; continue work in INF-4158. :white_check_mark:
